device.description: The block device path to monitor for SMART attributes.

check_type.description: The type of SMART check to perform: smart (health), temperature, or usage.

warning_threshold.description: A list of two integers [warn_level, crit_level] representing the thresholds for warning and critical states (percentage or raw value depending on attribute).

critical_threshold.description: A list of two integers [warn_level, crit_level] for critical-specific thresholds if separate from warning.

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode for detailed output.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the monitoring command execution.
